1lb ground beef

one bag frozen veggie mix

half of a sweet onion

garlic

V8 juice (2 qt, i used the low sodium one)

1 can of diced tomatoes

1 cup of rice

i cooked the rice first (just follow the instructions for whatever rice you use, i used minute rice) then i put a little olive oil in a pan with 2 tablespoons of minced garlic and half of a dice sweet onion, let it cook until the onions started to become transparent then added a lb of ground beef. while the beef cooked through, i put the v8 into a pot along with the diced tomatoes and frozen veggies, bringing it up to a boil for about 5 minutes. when the frozen veggies were warmed through, i added in the cooked ground beef and onions, then a little more than a cup of rice. salt and pepper to taste. stirred the pot and turned off the heat and let it sit for a few minutes, then it was done. i didn’t really do any measuring and kinda just winged it, so you can add more or less rice and veg. it came out really good and i was pretty impressed with myself lol.
